import sys

# Source character table (64 chars)
SRC = " ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ.,'?-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"

# Destination character table (32 chars)
DST = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ012345"

# Build encoding map:
# each source character maps to a 5-bit binary code equal to its index
enc = {ch: format(i, '05b') for i, ch in enumerate(SRC)}

# Build decoding map:
# each 5-bit group maps to a destination character equal to its value
dec = {format(i, '05b'): DST[i] for i in range(32)}

out = []
for line in sys.stdin.read().splitlines():
    bits = ''.join(enc[ch] for ch in line)
    # split into groups of 5 and decode
    converted = ''.join(dec[bits[i:i+5]] for i in range(0, len(bits), 5))
    out.append(converted)

sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))
